title: Beasts in Visions
summary: Beasts in prophetic visions often symbolize kingdoms, rulers, corrupt powers, and opposition to God.
background: Daniel and Revelation use beast imagery to portray worldly power in rebellion against God. The symbols are meant to reveal spiritual reality behind empire.
teachingHelp: Avoid treating beasts as mere fantasy. Explain their symbolic role in exposing arrogant power and calling saints to endurance.
